description: This file defines an Android activity called PresentationActivity that demonstrates using Android's Presentation API to display content on secondary displays. It manages available displays, presents different images and configurations on selected displays, and handles display events and user interactions.

classes.name: PresentationActivity
classes.description: Main activity that manages secondary display presentations and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, sets up UI components, and display management.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates display list and restores saved presentations.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters display listener and dismisses active presentations, saving their state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current presentation states to restore later.

methods.name: showPresentation
methods.description: Creates and displays a presentation on a given display with specified content.

methods.name: hidePresentation
methods.description: Dismisses the presentation on a given display.

methods.name: setPresentationDisplayMode
methods.description: Sets the display mode of an active presentation.

methods.name: getNextPhoto
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the next photo to display.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles checkbox toggle events for showing/hiding presentations and toggling display filtering.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Shows display info dialog when info button is clicked.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles no mode selection, resets display mode.

inner_classes.name: DisplayListAdapter
inner_classes.description: Adapter managing list of current displays and their UI representations.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates the view for a display list item.

inner_classes.name: DemoPresentation
inner_classes.description: Custom Presentation subclass to show content on secondary display, applying user-selected display modes and visual styles.

methods.name: setPreferredDisplayMode
methods.description: Sets the display mode for this presentation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes presentation view with image and background based on content.

inner_classes.name: DemoPresentationContents
inner_classes.description: Parcelable class holding data (photo index, colors, display mode) for presentation content.
